lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: You'll want the sourdough — everyone wants the sourdough — and you'll want to know why a stranger's been asking about the block. Both answers are on the counter and one of them is free.

lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: Three nights running there's been men out the front with a measure. The port's buying the whole corner for a container yard. I'm the last freehold on it, and the offer came down again this morning. Third time.

lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: Now. Offers go up when somebody wants a thing. Offers go down when somebody knows it's about to be worth less. And there's exactly one thing that happens to a brick building to make it worth less, and it isn't damp.

choices.text: Then we sit the night shift with you.
Sell, and be somewhere else when it happens.
